posts.headline: Nineteen editions of doubt and Thicks is still 4-0 at 530.16 points — fine, the ring might be real, but a title defense built on an easy schedule still hasn't been tested.
posts.detail: Tyrique14's Klint's Clipboard carries a 14-14 career mark and an average finish of 5.5 despite the one ring, so forgive me for not handing over the crown just because he's unbeaten through four.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 0-4 nightmare is now a full season-long crime scene, and that gaudy 20-8, 1.5-average-finish résumé is getting harder to defend by the week.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra has the best career pedigree in the entire league on paper, yet sits at 0-4 with 453.58 points — the furthest a contender has fallen from their own hype in Busters Anonymous history.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh drops to 1-3 and the 4-10 career record with a dead-last 12 average finish keeps proving the name was prophecy, not irony.
posts.detail: 444.18 points for the season isn't even the worst total in the league, but the bottom-feeder tier tag fits talentedtenthh like a glove at this point.

posts.headline: Sasinci slides to 2-2 and Big Head's 13-15 career mark means the Milk Man jokes aren't going anywhere even with a ring in the trophy case.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn's contender tag is carrying a 5.5 average finish and a sub-.500 all-time record, so 491.06 points through four weeks is exactly the kind of quietly mediocre output that keeps this franchise's legend complicated.

posts.headline: The Clown Show quietly sits 3-1 at 509.7 points, and btkempski's delusional Packers-superfan energy is somehow backed up by actual production this time.
posts.detail: A 15-13 career record and a best finish of 1 says this roster has been here before — the Alaskan Bull Worm might actually be surfacing at the right time.
